desc: Precompute capped factorials up to n (cap above 10^15) and determine initial odd/even counts for numbers 1..n.
Implement a helper that counts valid completions as (remaining odds)! * (remaining evens)!.
Construct the result position by position: try unused numbers of the allowed parity in increasing order and subtract block sizes until k fits.
Handle the first position separately (feasibility by parity) and enforce forced alternation parity for all later positions.
Return empty list when k exceeds the total count; handle n=1 explicitly.
